name: Festivly
author: Festivly
description: Push live on/off status, the current song, and nightly schedule hours to your festivly.app listing. Visitors can request the next song from the listing while the show is playing.

privacy.summary: Sends this player's playlist start/stop, current song title, and schedule hours to the festivly.app listing you configure. The signing token stays on this device.

sends.what: Display ID (user-configured identifier), player status (playing/idle), current song title and artist, current sequence name, next song title, seconds remaining in current song, nightly schedule entries (start/stop times and days of week)
sends.why: To update the public Festivly listing with real-time show status and enable visitors to request songs from the available playlist. Schedule sync allows the listing to show when the show is expected to run.

collects: Festivly display id and signing token, stored in this player's config
privacy.remoteAccess: outbound HTTPS to www.festivly.com (festivly.app redirects there)
systemChanges: adds a minutely cron entry for the fpp user to poll Festivly for song requests
